CREATE VIEW dbo.CDR_CHECK_REPORT as 
SELECT
	s.PATIENT_ID + '|' + S.VISIT_ID + '|' + s.ORDER_NO + '|' + CONVERT ( VARCHAR ( 50 ), r.REPORT_SEQ ) AS ROWKEY,
	s.PATIENT_ID AS OUT_PATIENT_ID,-- 门诊患者标识
	s.PATIENT_ID AS IN_PATIENT_ID,-- 住院患者标识
	s.PATIENT_ID AS INP_NO,-- 住院号
	'' AS HEALTH_CARD_NO,-- 健康卡号
	'' AS CASE_NO,-- 病案号
	'' AS PLS_NO,-- 病理号
	s.PATIENT_ID AS OUTP_NO,-- 门诊号
	S.VISIT_ID AS VISIT_ID,-- 就诊流水号
	( CASE s.PATIENT_CLASS_CODE WHEN 'I' THEN '02' WHEN 'O' THEN '01' ELSE '00' END ) AS VISIT_TYPE_CODE,-- 就诊类型编码
	( CASE s.PATIENT_CLASS_CODE WHEN 'I' THEN '住院' WHEN 'O' THEN '门诊' ELSE '其他' END ) AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME,-- 就诊类型名称
	s.PATIENT_NAME AS PERSON_NAME,-- 姓名
	( CASE S.SEX_CODE WHEN 'M' THEN '1' WHEN 'F' THEN '2' ELSE '0' END ) AS SEX_CODE,-- 性别编码
	( CASE S.SEX_CODE WHEN 'M' THEN '男' WHEN 'F' THEN '女' END ) AS SEX_NAME,-- 性别名称
	s.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH,-- 出生日期
	s.AGE AS AGE_UNIT,-- 年龄单位
	'' AS AGE_VALUE,-- 年龄值
	'' AS ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE,-- 证件类型编码
	'' AS ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME,-- 证件类型名称
	'' AS ID_CARD_NO,-- 证件号码
	'' AS PHONE_NUMBER,-- 电话
	'' AS ORDER_NO,-- 医嘱序号
	'' AS ORDER_ITEM_CODE,-- 医嘱项编码
	'' AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME,-- 医嘱项名称
	'' AS CHARGE_ITEM_CODE,-- 收费项编码
	'' AS CHARGE_ITEM_NAME,-- 收费项名称
	s.ORDER_NO AS APPLY_NO,-- 申请号
	'' AS MSR_NO,-- 放射号
	s.STUDY_CLASS_CODE AS EXAM_CLASS_CODE,-- 检查类别编码
	s.STUDY_CLASS AS EXAM_CLASS_NAME,-- 检查类别名称
	s.STUDY_ITEM_CODE AS EXAM_ITEM_CODE,-- 检查项目编码
	s.STUDY_ITEM AS EXAM_ITEM_NAME,-- 检查项目名称
	'' AS PLAN_EXAM_ROOM,-- 拟检查室
	'' AS PLAN_EXAM_DOCTOR_CODE,-- 拟检查医师工号
	'' AS PLAN_EXAM_DOCTOR_NAME,-- 拟检查医师姓名
	'' AS PLAN_EXAM_DEVICE,-- 拟检查设备号
	'' AS APPOINT_DOCTOR_CODE,-- 预约医师工号
	'' AS APPOINT_DOCTOR_NAME,-- 预约医师姓名
	'' AS EXAM_APPOINT_TIME,-- 预约时间
	'' AS PLAN_EXAM_TIME,-- 拟检查时间
	'' AS APPLY_DOCTOR_CODE,-- 申请医师工号
	o.ORDER_PHYSICIAN AS APPLY_DOCTOR_NAME,-- 申请医师姓名
	o.ORDER_DEPARTMENT AS APPLY_DEPT_CODE,-- 申请科室编码
	o.ORDER_DATE_TIME AS APPLY_TIME_NAME,-- 申请时间名称
	'' AS RIS_CHECK_OPER_CODE,-- 登记人工号
	'' AS RIS_CHECK_OPER_NAME,-- 登记人姓名
	'' AS RIS_CHECK_TIME,-- 登记时间
	o.STUDY_DEPARTMENT AS EXAM_ROOM,-- 检查室
	'' AS EXAM_NO,-- 检查序号
	r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR AS PERFORM_DOCTOR,-- 检查医师
	'' AS EXAM_DEVICE_SN,-- 检查设备编码
	'心电图机' AS EXAM_DEVICE_NAME,-- 检查设备名称
	'其他' AS EXAM_PART_CODE,-- 检查部位编码
	'心脏' AS EXAM_PART_NAME,-- 检查部位名称
	'0' AS EXAM_METHOD_CODE,-- 检查方法编码
	'0' AS EXAM_METHOD_NAME,-- 检查方法名称
	'' AS EXAM_PERFORM_TIME,-- 检查执行时间
	r.REPORT_SEQ AS REPORT_NO,-- 报告号
	r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR_ID AS REPORT_DOCTOR_CODE,-- 报告医师工号
	r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR AS REPORT_DOCTOR_NAME,-- 报告医师姓名
	r.CONFIRM_DATE_TIME AS REPORT_TIME,-- 报告时间
	r.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT AS REPORT_TEXT,-- 报告内容
	('http://10.10.10.80:5679/Start.aspx?UserID=his&UserPwd=his&OrderNo='+s.ORDER_NO) AS PACS_URL,-- 影像链接
	'' AS PACS_URL_LINK,-- 影响链接标识
	('http://10.10.10.80:5679/Start.aspx?UserID=his&UserPwd=his&OrderNo='+s.ORDER_NO) AS PACS_IMG,-- 影像图片
	'' AS PACS_IMG_LINK,-- 影像图片标识
	r.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT AS EXAM_FEATURE,-- 检查所见
	r.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT AS EXAM_DIAG,-- 检查诊断
	'2' AS REPORT_STATUS_CODE,-- 报告状态编码
	'正常' AS REPORT_STATUS_NAME,-- 报告状态名称
	r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR_ID AS REPORT_CONFIRMER_CODE,-- 报告审核医师工号
	r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR AS REPORT_CONFIRMER_NAME,-- 报告审核医师姓名
	r.CONFIRM_DATE_TIME AS REPORT_CONFIRM_TIME,-- 报告审核时间
	'' AS ABORT_OPERATOR_CODE,-- 作废人工号
	'' AS ABORT_OPERATOR_NAME,-- 作废人姓名
	'' AS ABORT_DATETIME -- 作废时间
	
FROM
	STUDY_TBL AS s
	INNER JOIN REPORT_TBL AS r ON s.STUDY_SEQ = r.STUDY_SEQ 
	inner join ORDER_TBL as o on s.PATIENT_ID = o.PATIENT_ID
	and s.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO
WHERE
	( s.STUDY_STATUS = '5' ) 
	AND ( s.ORDER_NO <> '' ) 
	AND ( r.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT <> '' ) 
	AND ( s.AGE <> '' )

CREATE VIEW ECG_EXAM_INFO
AS
select st.patient_id as patient_id  --患者ID
, st.VISIT_ID as visit_sn  --单次就诊唯一标识号
, CASE 
WHEN st.PATIENT_CLASS_CODE = 'I' 
THEN '住院' 
WHEN st.PATIENT_CLASS_CODE = 'O' 
THEN '门诊' 
ELSE '住院' 
END as visit_type  --就诊类型
, st.VISIT_ID as visit_card_no  --就诊卡号
, st.VISIT_ID as outpatient_no  --门诊号
, st.VISIT_ID as visit_times  --就诊次数
, st.VISIT_ID as medical_record_no  --病案号
, st.VISIT_ID as inpatient_no  --住院号
, st.VISIT_ID as hospitalization_times  --住院次数
, st.PATIENT_NAME as name  --患者姓名
, st.ORDER_NO as apply_no  --申请单号
, st.ORDER_NO as order_sn  --申请医嘱流水号
, st.ORDER_DATE_TIME as apply_datetime  --申请时间
, st.ORDER_DEPARTMENT_CODE as apply_dept_code  --申请科室代码
, st.ORDER_DEPARTMENT as apply_dept_name  --申请科室名称
, st.STUDY_SEQ as exam_sn  --检查流水号
, st.STUDY_DATE_TIME as exam_datetime  --检查时间
, '心电' as exam_type  --检查类型
, st.STUDY_CLASS as exam_item_type  --检查项目类型
, st.STUDY_ITEM_CODE as exam_item_code  --检查项目代码
, st.STUDY_ITEM as exam_item_name  --检查项目名称
, '心脏' as exam_sites  --检查部位
, CONVERT(varchar(25), st.STUDY_SEQ) + '_' + CONVERT(varchar(25), rt.REPORT_SEQ) as report_no  --报告单号
, rt.CONFIRM_DATE_TIME as report_datetime  --报告时间
, st.STUDY_DEPARTMENT_CODE as report_dept_code  --报告科室代码
, st.STUDY_DEPARTMENT as report_dept_name  --报告科室名称
, rt.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT as exam_diag_description  --检查所见
, rt.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT as exam_diag_conclusion  --检查结论
, '' as extend_data1  --扩展字段1
, '' as extend_data2  --扩展字段2
, '1' as record_status  --记录状态

FROM [EDSChinaDB].[dbo].[STUDY_TBL] st
, [EDSChinaDB].[dbo].[REPORT_TBL] rt


where st.STUDY_SEQ = rt.STUDY_SEQ
  and st.PATIENT_CLASS_CODE in ('I','O')
  and st.STUDY_STATUS = '5'
  and st.OPERATING_STATUS = '4.2'

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_ECG_BS25011]
AS
SELECT     st.ORDER_MEMO AS ROWID, st.STUDY_SEQ AS PE_NO, st.ORDER_NO AS ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO, st.STUDY_ITEM_CODE AS EXAM_ITEM_CODE, st.STUDY_ITEM AS EXAM_ITEM_NAMEgg, 
                      st.PATIENT_NAME AS PAT_NAMEg, CASE st.SEX_CODE WHEN 'F' THEN '女' WHEN 'M' THEN '男' ELSE '不确定' END AS PHYSI_SEX_NAME, 
                      rt.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT AS EXAM_RESULT, 'ftp://NAS:EDS_China@10.10.10.80/cardioNet/FileDBData/' + REPLACE(dt.PATH, '\', '/') AS IMG_PATH, 
                      rt.CONFIRM_DOCTOR_ID AS EXECUT_DR_CODE, rt.CONFIRM_DOCTOR AS EXECUT_DR_NAME, rt.CONFIRM_DATE_TIME AS EXECUT_DATE, rt.CONFIRM_DOCTOR_ID AS PROOF_DR_CODE, 
                      rt.CONFIRM_DOCTOR AS PROOF_DR_NAME, rt.CONFIRM_DATE_TIME AS PROOF_DATE, '' AS CURR_QUEUE_NO
FROM         dbo.STUDY_TBL AS st INNER JOIN
                      dbo.REPORT_TBL AS rt ON st.STUDY_SEQ = rt.STUDY_SEQ INNER JOIN
                      dbo.DATA_TBL AS dt ON st.STUDY_SEQ = dt.STUDY_SEQ AND rt.REPORT_SEQ = dt.REPORT_SEQ AND rt.VERSION_NO = dt.VERSION_NO
WHERE     (st.STUDY_STATUS = '5') AND (st.OPERATING_STATUS = '4.2') AND (st.PATIENT_CLASS_CODE = 'C') AND (st.RELEVANT_LAB_TEST = 'NewTJ') AND 
                      (dt.DATA_FORMAT = 'PDF')

CREATE VIEW dbo.YJ_JCBG
AS
SELECT     'YLV21051' AS YLJGDM, r.REPORT_SEQ AS JCBGDH, '山东省第二人民医院' AS YLJGMC, s.ORDER_NO AS JCSQDH, 
                      CASE WHEN S.REGIST_DATE_TIME < '2023-04-25 15:40' THEN S.VISIT_ID ELSE S.PHYS_SIGN END AS JZLSH, 
                      CASE s.PATIENT_CLASS_CODE WHEN 'I' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS SFZY, '' AS BAH, s.PATIENT_NAME AS HZXM, 
                      CASE S.SEX_CODE WHEN 'M' THEN '1' WHEN 'F' THEN '2' ELSE '0' END AS XBDM, CASE S.SEX_CODE WHEN 'M' THEN '男' WHEN 'F' THEN '女' END AS XBMC, 
                      s.AGE AS NLN, '' AS NLY, '' AS NLR, s.ORDER_DEPARTMENT AS KSMC, '' AS BQBM, s.AREA AS BQMC, s.WARD AS BFHM, s.WARD AS BFMC, s.SICKBED AS BCH, 
                      s.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS CSRQ, s.ORDER_DATE_TIME AS SQRQ, s.ORDER_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS SQKSDM, s.ORDER_DEPARTMENT AS SQKSMC, 
                      s.ORDER_PHYSICIAN_ID AS SQRGH, s.ORDER_PHYSICIAN AS SQRXM, '' AS CYRQ, s.REGIST_DATE_TIME AS DJSJ, '' AS PHRGH, '' AS PHRXM, '' AS JSSJ, 
                      '' AS JSRGH, '' AS JSRXM, s.STUDY_DATE_TIME AS JCRQ, s.STUDY_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS JCKSDM, s.STUDY_DEPARTMENT AS JCKSMC, 
                      s.STUDY_ITEM_CODE AS JCXMDM, s.STUDY_ITEM AS JCXMMC, '' AS JCSBDM, '心电图机' AS JCSBMC, s.STUDY_CLASS_CODE AS JCXMLXDM, 
                      s.STUDY_CLASS AS JCXMLXMC, r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR_ID AS JCYSGH, r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR AS JCYSXM, '其他' AS JCBWDM, '心脏' AS JCBWMC, '0' AS JCFSDM, 
                      '0' AS JCFSMC, r.CONFIRM_DATE_TIME AS BGRQ, r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR_ID AS BGYSGH, r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR AS BGYSXM, 
                      s.STUDY_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS JCBGKSDM, s.STUDY_DEPARTMENT AS JCBGKSMC, '山东省耳鼻喉医院' AS JCBGJGMC, '2' AS BGDLBDM, '1' AS JCJGDM, 
                      '2' AS JCBGZTDM, '正常' AS JCBGZTMC, r.CONFIRM_DATE_TIME AS SHRQSJ, r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR_ID AS SHYSGH, r.CONFIRM_DOCTOR AS SHYSXM, 
                      r.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT AS JCMS, r.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT AS JCJG, '' AS JCJYJGDM, '' AS JCDLJG, '' AS JCDLJGDW, '' AS JCBGJGKGSJ, '' AS JCBGJGZGTS, 
                      '' AS JCJGSFYX, '' AS JCBGBZ, '心电图报告单' AS JCBGDMC, 'N' AS MJ, GETDATE() AS TBRQ, r.CONFIRM_DATE_TIME AS XGRQ, '1' AS XGBZ
FROM         dbo.STUDY_TBL AS s INNER JOIN
                      dbo.REPORT_TBL AS r ON s.STUDY_SEQ = r.STUDY_SEQ
WHERE     (s.STUDY_STATUS = '5') AND (s.ORDER_NO <> '') AND (r.DIAGNOSE_COMMENT <> '') AND (s.AGE <> '')
